question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"Neither the regional manager nor the branch cashiers (A)/ was present in the currency vault (B)/ when the alarm triggered (C)/ during the unscheduled security drill. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"Neither the regional manager nor the branch cashiers (A)/ was present in the currency vault (B)/ when the alarm triggered (C)/ during the unscheduled security drill. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: In 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject nearest to it. 'cashiers' is plural, so use 'were present', not 'was present'.
explanation.hi: 'neither... nor' में क्रिया निकटतम कर्ता के अनुसार होती है। 'cashiers' बहुवचन है, अतः 'were' का प्रयोग होगा।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'Subject-Verb Concord (Proximity)'.
Elimination: Look closely at parts B and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: Cover the first subject. Only check 'cashiers was' -> error!

examTip.en: Exam Tip: Cover the first subject. Only check 'cashiers was' -> error!
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: Cover the first subject. Only check 'cashiers was' -> error!

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: Don't add both subjects together. Proximity governs!
trapAlert.hi: ट्रैप अलर्ट: Don't add both subjects together. Proximity governs!

question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"The Chairman and Managing Director, (A)/ along with senior audit officers, (B)/ have scheduled an emergency board meeting (C)/ to address the liquidity shortfall. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"The Chairman and Managing Director, (A)/ along with senior audit officers, (B)/ have scheduled an emergency board meeting (C)/ to address the liquidity shortfall. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: When joined by 'along with', the verb agrees with the first subject ('Chairman and Managing Director', singular). Therefore, use 'has scheduled', not 'have scheduled'.
explanation.hi: 'along with' से जुड़ने पर क्रिया प्रथम कर्ता ('Chairman and Managing Director', एकवचन) के अनुसार होगी। 'has scheduled' सही है।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'Subject-Verb Concord (First Subject)'.
Elimination: Look closely at parts C and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: Ignore everything between commas starting with 'along with'.

examTip.en: Exam Tip: Ignore everything between commas starting with 'along with'.
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: Ignore everything between commas starting with 'along with'.

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: The plural noun 'officers' is placed right before the verb to trap you.
trapAlert.hi: ट्रैप अलर्ट: The plural noun 'officers' is placed right before the verb to trap you.

ruleTested: One of the + Plural Noun + Relative Clause

question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"He is one of the most dedicated loan recovery officers (A)/ who has ever worked (B)/ in this rural development bank (C)/ since its establishment. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"He is one of the most dedicated loan recovery officers (A)/ who has ever worked (B)/ in this rural development bank (C)/ since its establishment. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: 'One of the + plural noun + who' takes a plural verb because 'who' refers to the plural antecedent ('officers'). Use 'who have ever worked'.
explanation.hi: 'One of the + बहुवचन संज्ञा + who' में क्रिया बहुवचन होती है क्योंकि 'who' का पूर्ववर्ती 'officers' है। 'have' आएगा।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'One of the + Plural Noun + Relative Clause'.
Elimination: Look closely at parts B and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: Formula: One of the + Plural Noun + who + PLURAL VERB.

examTip.en: Exam Tip: Formula: One of the + Plural Noun + who + PLURAL VERB.
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: Formula: One of the + Plural Noun + who + PLURAL VERB.

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: Don't get tricked by the word 'One'; look for the relative pronoun 'who'.
trapAlert.hi: ट्रैप अलर्ट: Don't get tricked by the word 'One'; look for the relative pronoun 'who'.

ruleTested: A number of vs The number of

question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"The number of fraudulent online transactions (A)/ reported through payment aggregators (B)/ have increased noticeably (C)/ over the past financial quarter. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"The number of fraudulent online transactions (A)/ reported through payment aggregators (B)/ have increased noticeably (C)/ over the past financial quarter. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: 'The number of' specifies a single mathematical statistic and requires a singular verb ('has increased', not 'have increased').
explanation.hi: 'The number of' एक निश्चित संख्या को दर्शाता है और एकवचन क्रिया ('has increased') लेता है।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'A number of vs The number of'.
Elimination: Look closely at parts C and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: 'A number of' = Plural verb; 'The number of' = Singular verb.

examTip.en: Exam Tip: 'A number of' = Plural verb; 'The number of' = Singular verb.
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: 'A number of' = Plural verb; 'The number of' = Singular verb.

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: Seeing 'transactions' right before the verb tricks students into using 'have'.
trapAlert.hi: ट्रैप अलर्ट: Seeing 'transactions' right before the verb tricks students into using 'have'.

question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"Ten thousand rupees are (A)/ an excessive penalty (B)/ for a minor delay (C)/ in submitting annual income tax returns. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"Ten thousand rupees are (A)/ an excessive penalty (B)/ for a minor delay (C)/ in submitting annual income tax returns. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: When a specific sum of money is regarded as a single unified amount, it takes a singular verb. Use 'is an excessive penalty', not 'are'.
explanation.hi: जब धन की निश्चित राशि को एक इकाई माना जाए, तो एकवचन क्रिया ('is') का प्रयोग होता है।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'Units of Money / Measurement'.
Elimination: Look closely at parts A and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: Predicate specifies 'an excessive penalty' (singular noun phrase).

examTip.en: Exam Tip: Predicate specifies 'an excessive penalty' (singular noun phrase).
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: Predicate specifies 'an excessive penalty' (singular noun phrase).

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: Rupees is plural, but the lump sum concept is singular.
trapAlert.hi: ट्रैप अलर्ट: Rupees is plural, but the lump sum concept is singular.

ruleTested: Simple Past with Past Time Marker

question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"The Reserve Bank of India has announced (A)/ a significant relaxation in PSL targets (B)/ during the monetary policy press conference (C)/ yesterday afternoon. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"The Reserve Bank of India has announced (A)/ a significant relaxation in PSL targets (B)/ during the monetary policy press conference (C)/ yesterday afternoon. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: Definite past time adverbs like 'yesterday' prohibit Present Perfect ('has announced'). Use Simple Past 'announced'.
explanation.hi: 'Yesterday' जैसे भूतकालिक समय सूचक के साथ Present Perfect नहीं, बल्कि Simple Past ('announced') प्रयुक्त होता है।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'Simple Past with Past Time Marker'.
Elimination: Look closely at parts A and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: Look for 'yesterday/ago/last year' -> strike out 'has/have' immediately!

examTip.en: Exam Tip: Look for 'yesterday/ago/last year' -> strike out 'has/have' immediately!
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: Look for 'yesterday/ago/last year' -> strike out 'has/have' immediately!

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: Colloquially people say 'has done yesterday', which exams strictly mark wrong.
trapAlert.hi: ट्रैप अलर्ट: Colloquially people say 'has done yesterday', which exams strictly mark wrong.

question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"The branch accountant already reconciled (A)/ the daily clearing entries (B)/ before the external statutory auditor (C)/ arrived at the regional office. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"The branch accountant already reconciled (A)/ the daily clearing entries (B)/ before the external statutory auditor (C)/ arrived at the regional office. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: When two actions occurred in the past, the earlier completed action takes Past Perfect ('had already reconciled').
explanation.hi: भूतकाल के दो कार्यों में से पहले पूर्ण कार्य के लिए Past Perfect ('had already reconciled') का प्रयोग होता है।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'Past Perfect in Double Actions'.
Elimination: Look closely at parts A and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: First action = had + V3; Second action = V2.

examTip.en: Exam Tip: First action = had + V3; Second action = V2.
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: First action = had + V3; Second action = V2.

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: Do not use simple past for both actions separated by 'before'.
trapAlert.hi: ट्रैप अलर्ट: Do not use simple past for both actions separated by 'before'.

ruleTested: Stative Verbs Prohibited in Continuous Tense

question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"The Chief Financial Officer is knowing (A)/ the exact implications of (B)/ the recent credit rating downgrade (C)/ on sovereign bond yields. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"The Chief Financial Officer is knowing (A)/ the exact implications of (B)/ the recent credit rating downgrade (C)/ on sovereign bond yields. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: 'Know' is a stative verb of cognition and cannot be used in continuous tense. Use 'knows', not 'is knowing'.
explanation.hi: 'Know' एक stative verb है, इसका प्रयोग continuous tense ('is knowing') में नहीं किया जा सकता। 'knows' सही है।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'Stative Verbs Prohibited in Continuous Tense'.
Elimination: Look closely at parts A and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: Check -ing on mental/perception verbs: knowing, understanding, believing = WRONG.

examTip.en: Exam Tip: Check -ing on mental/perception verbs: knowing, understanding, believing = WRONG.
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: Check -ing on mental/perception verbs: knowing, understanding, believing = WRONG.

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: Do not confuse with participial adjectives ('knowing smile').
trapAlert.hi: ट्रैप अलर्ट: Do not confuse with participial adjectives ('knowing smile').

question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"She is managing the microfinance recovery wing (A)/ of this public sector bank (B)/ since the last five years (C)/ with commendable integrity. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"She is managing the microfinance recovery wing (A)/ of this public sector bank (B)/ since the last five years (C)/ with commendable integrity. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: Two errors: Ongoing action with time requires Present Perfect Continuous ('has been managing'), and duration of time requires 'for', not 'since'.
explanation.hi: समयावधि के साथ जारी कार्य हेतु 'has been managing' तथा अवधि के लिए 'for' का प्रयोग होगा।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'Present Perfect Continuous with For'.
Elimination: Look closely at parts A and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: Duration of counted years = FOR; starting calendar year = SINCE.

examTip.en: Exam Tip: Duration of counted years = FOR; starting calendar year = SINCE.
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: Duration of counted years = FOR; starting calendar year = SINCE.

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: 'Since the last five years' is a very common spoken blunder.
trapAlert.hi: ट्रैप अलर्ट: 'Since the last five years' is a very common spoken blunder.

question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"Every scheduled commercial bank must (A)/ strictly adhere with the guidelines (B)/ issued by the regulatory body (C)/ regarding capital adequacy norms. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"Every scheduled commercial bank must (A)/ strictly adhere with the guidelines (B)/ issued by the regulatory body (C)/ regarding capital adequacy norms. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: 'Adhere' strictly takes the fixed preposition 'to', never 'with'. Use 'adhere to the guidelines'.
explanation.hi: 'Adhere' के साथ सदैव निश्चित पूर्वसर्ग 'to' आता है, 'with' नहीं।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'Fixed Preposition with Adhere'.
Elimination: Look closely at parts B and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: Adhere TO, Abide BY, Comply WITH, Conform TO.

examTip.en: Exam Tip: Adhere TO, Abide BY, Comply WITH, Conform TO.
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: Adhere TO, Abide BY, Comply WITH, Conform TO.

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: Students often confuse 'comply with' with 'adhere to'.
trapAlert.hi: ट्रैप अलर्ट: Students often confuse 'comply with' with 'adhere to'.

question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"The senior vigilance committee met (A)/ to thoroughly discuss about (B)/ the forensic audit findings (C)/ of the stressed thermal power project. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"The senior vigilance committee met (A)/ to thoroughly discuss about (B)/ the forensic audit findings (C)/ of the stressed thermal power project. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: 'Discuss' is a transitive verb meaning 'talk about'. Adding 'about' is an error of redundant preposition. Use 'discuss the findings'.
explanation.hi: 'Discuss' एक सकर्मक क्रिया है, इसके बाद 'about' का प्रयोग अशुद्ध और निरर्थक है।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'Redundant Preposition after Discuss'.
Elimination: Look closely at parts B and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: No preposition after: discuss, describe, order, request, reach, enter.

examTip.en: Exam Tip: No preposition after: discuss, describe, order, request, reach, enter.
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: No preposition after: discuss, describe, order, request, reach, enter.

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: 'Discuss about' is ubiquitous in colloquial Indian English.
trapAlert.hi: ट्रैप अलर्ट: 'Discuss about' is ubiquitous in colloquial Indian English.

ruleTested: Cope With vs Cope Up With

question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"The new retail branch manager found it (A)/ extremely difficult to (B)/ cope up with the immense workload (C)/ during the annual financial closing. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"The new retail branch manager found it (A)/ extremely difficult to (B)/ cope up with the immense workload (C)/ during the annual financial closing. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: The correct English idiom is 'cope with' (to manage successfully). 'Cope up with' is a non-standard grammatical error.
explanation.hi: अंग्रेजी में सही मुहावरा 'cope with' है, 'cope up with' सर्वथा अशुद्ध है।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'Cope With vs Cope Up With'.
Elimination: Look closely at parts C and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: Strike out 'up'! Just 'cope with'.

examTip.en: Exam Tip: Strike out 'up'! Just 'cope with'.
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: Strike out 'up'! Just 'cope with'.

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: One of the most frequently asked preposition traps in banking history.
trapAlert.hi: ट्रैप अलर्ट: One of the most frequently asked preposition traps in banking history.

question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"There is a longstanding dispute (A)/ regarding inter-branch currency allocation (B)/ among the two premier corporate offices (C)/ located in the metro city. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"There is a longstanding dispute (A)/ regarding inter-branch currency allocation (B)/ among the two premier corporate offices (C)/ located in the metro city. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: 'Between' is used when referring to two distinct entities. 'Among' is for three or more. Since there are 'two premier corporate offices', use 'between'.
explanation.hi: दो संस्थाओं के संदर्भ में 'between' का प्रयोग होता है, 'among' तीन या अधिक के लिए होता है।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'Between vs Among'.
Elimination: Look closely at parts C and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: Count the entities: 2 = Between; 3+ = Among.

examTip.en: Exam Tip: Count the entities: 2 = Between; 3+ = Among.
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: Count the entities: 2 = Between; 3+ = Among.

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: Don't miss the word 'two' embedded in the phrase.
trapAlert.hi: ट्रैप अलर्ट: Don't miss the word 'two' embedded in the phrase.

question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"If the branch manager would have verified (A)/ the borrower's collateral documents meticulously, (B)/ the bad loan could have been averted (C)/ at the initial sanction stage. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"If the branch manager would have verified (A)/ the borrower's collateral documents meticulously, (B)/ the bad loan could have been averted (C)/ at the initial sanction stage. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: The conditional 'if' clause in the third conditional must take 'had + V3', NEVER 'would have'. Use 'If the branch manager had verified'.
explanation.hi: तीसरी शर्त (Third Conditional) के 'if' उपवाक्य में 'had + V3' आता है, 'would have' नहीं।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'Third Conditional If-Clause'.
Elimination: Look closely at parts A and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: 'Would have' can NEVER sit in the 'if' clause!

examTip.en: Exam Tip: 'Would have' can NEVER sit in the 'if' clause!
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: 'Would have' can NEVER sit in the 'if' clause!

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: Inverted alternative: 'Had the branch manager verified...' is also correct.
trapAlert.hi: ट्रैप अलर्ट: Inverted alternative: 'Had the branch manager verified...' is also correct.

question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"If I was the Chief Executive Officer (A)/ of this multinational lending institution, (B)/ I would prioritize digital inclusion (C)/ over aggressive brick-and-mortar expansion. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"If I was the Chief Executive Officer (A)/ of this multinational lending institution, (B)/ I would prioritize digital inclusion (C)/ over aggressive brick-and-mortar expansion. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: In unreal, hypothetical, or imaginary conditions, the subjunctive verb 'were' must be used for all grammatical persons. Use 'If I were'.
explanation.hi: काल्पनिक या अवास्तविक शर्त में सभी कर्ताओं के साथ subjunctive 'were' का प्रयोग होता है ('If I were')।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'Subjunctive Mood 'Were''.
Elimination: Look closely at parts A and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: Imaginary/Unreal = ALWAYS 'WERE'.

examTip.en: Exam Tip: Imaginary/Unreal = ALWAYS 'WERE'.
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: Imaginary/Unreal = ALWAYS 'WERE'.

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: Thinking 'was' is correct because 'I' is singular is a fatal exam mistake.
trapAlert.hi: ट्रैप अलर्ट: Thinking 'was' is correct because 'I' is singular is a fatal exam mistake.

question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"Unless the borrower does not furnish (A)/ the certified income statement (B)/ within forty-eight hours, (C)/ the loan application will be summarily rejected. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"Unless the borrower does not furnish (A)/ the certified income statement (B)/ within forty-eight hours, (C)/ the loan application will be summarily rejected. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: 'Unless' already means 'if not' (negative). Using 'does not' creates a forbidden double negative. Use 'Unless the borrower furnishes'.
explanation.hi: 'Unless' में नकारात्मक अर्थ ('यदि नहीं') निहित है, इसके साथ 'does not' का प्रयोग वर्जित है।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'Double Negative with Unless'.
Elimination: Look closely at parts A and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: Unless / Until + Positive verb clause.

examTip.en: Exam Tip: Unless / Until + Positive verb clause.
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: Unless / Until + Positive verb clause.

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: Watch for 'does not', 'did not', 'cannot' inside an 'unless' clause.
trapAlert.hi: ट्रैप अलर्ट: Watch for 'does not', 'did not', 'cannot' inside an 'unless' clause.

question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"Scarcely had the core banking server restarted (A)/ than an overwhelming influx of mobile transactions (B)/ caused the load balancer to malfunction (C)/ once again. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"Scarcely had the core banking server restarted (A)/ than an overwhelming influx of mobile transactions (B)/ caused the load balancer to malfunction (C)/ once again. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: 'Scarcely' and 'Hardly' must pair strictly with 'when' (or 'before'), NEVER with 'than'. Use 'when an overwhelming influx'.
explanation.hi: 'Scarcely' और 'Hardly' का निश्चित युग्म 'when' के साथ बनता है, 'than' के साथ नहीं।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'Scarcely / Hardly... When'.
Elimination: Look closely at parts B and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: Scarcely/Hardly ➔ WHEN. No sooner ➔ THAN.

examTip.en: Exam Tip: Scarcely/Hardly ➔ WHEN. No sooner ➔ THAN.
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: Scarcely/Hardly ➔ WHEN. No sooner ➔ THAN.

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: Examiners swap 'than' and 'when' to confuse students.
trapAlert.hi: ट्रैप अलर्ट: Examiners swap 'than' and 'when' to confuse students.

question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"No sooner did the treasury officer entered (A)/ the forex trading floor (B)/ than the rupee registered a sharp recovery (C)/ against the US dollar. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"No sooner did the treasury officer entered (A)/ the forex trading floor (B)/ than the rupee registered a sharp recovery (C)/ against the US dollar. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: After the auxiliary verb 'did', the main verb must always be in its base form (V1). Use 'enter', not 'entered'.
explanation.hi: सहायक क्रिया 'did' के बाद मुख्य क्रिया का मूल रूप (V1) प्रयुक्त होता है ('enter', न कि 'entered')।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'Did + Base Verb (V1)'.
Elimination: Look closely at parts A and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: Do / Does / Did + V1.

examTip.en: Exam Tip: Do / Does / Did + V1.
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: Do / Does / Did + V1.

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: The mind focuses on 'No sooner... than' and misses the basic 'did + entered' violation.
trapAlert.hi: ट्रैप अलर्ट: The mind focuses on 'No sooner... than' and misses the basic 'did + entered' violation.

ruleTested: Parallelism with Not Only... But Also

question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"The digital lending startup not only offered (A)/ zero collateral micro-loans (B)/ but also provided customized financial literacy modules (C)/ to rural women entrepreneurs. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"The digital lending startup not only offered (A)/ zero collateral micro-loans (B)/ but also provided customized financial literacy modules (C)/ to rural women entrepreneurs. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: The sentence is grammatically flawless. 'Not only' is followed by a verb phrase ('offered...'), and 'but also' is followed by a parallel verb phrase ('provided...').
explanation.hi: वाक्य पूर्णतः शुद्ध है। 'not only' और 'but also' दोनों के बाद समानांतर क्रियाएँ प्रयुक्त हैं।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'Parallelism with Not Only... But Also'.
Elimination: Look closely at parts E and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: Check parallelism: Verb 1 matches Verb 2.

examTip.en: Exam Tip: Check parallelism: Verb 1 matches Verb 2.
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: Check parallelism: Verb 1 matches Verb 2.

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: Do not invent errors when the structure is genuinely parallel! Choose (E).
trapAlert.hi: ट्रैप अलर्ट: Do not invent errors when the structure is genuinely parallel! Choose (E).

question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"Walk cautiously through the construction zone (A)/ in the banking complex (B)/ lest you should not slip (C)/ on the freshly polished wet marble floor. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"Walk cautiously through the construction zone (A)/ in the banking complex (B)/ lest you should not slip (C)/ on the freshly polished wet marble floor. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: 'Lest' means 'for fear that' and is inherently negative; it cannot take 'not'. Use 'lest you should slip'.
explanation.hi: 'Lest' का अर्थ 'कहीं ऐसा न हो कि' है। इसके साथ 'not' का प्रयोग वर्जित है। 'lest you should slip' सही है।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'Lest + Should (No Negative)'.
Elimination: Look closely at parts C and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: Lest + Subject + SHOULD (Drop 'not').

examTip.en: Exam Tip: Lest + Subject + SHOULD (Drop 'not').
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: Lest + Subject + SHOULD (Drop 'not').

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: Thinking 'lest' needs 'not' to express prevention.
trapAlert.hi: ट्रैप अलर्ट: Thinking 'lest' needs 'not' to express prevention.

question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"Investment in sovereign gold bonds is (A)/ much more preferable than (B)/ holding depreciating cash (C)/ in a low-interest savings account. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"Investment in sovereign gold bonds is (A)/ much more preferable than (B)/ holding depreciating cash (C)/ in a low-interest savings account. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: 'Preferable' already contains comparative force and takes the preposition 'to', not 'than'. Furthermore, 'more' cannot precede it. Use 'much preferable to'.
explanation.hi: 'Preferable' के साथ 'to' आता है ('than' नहीं) और इसके पूर्व 'more' का प्रयोग वर्जित है।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'Preferable To (No 'More', No 'Than')'.
Elimination: Look closely at parts B and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: Preferable + TO (never 'more preferable than').

examTip.en: Exam Tip: Preferable + TO (never 'more preferable than').
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: Preferable + TO (never 'more preferable than').

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: Colloquial speech commonly abuses 'more preferable'.
trapAlert.hi: ट्रैप अलर्ट: Colloquial speech commonly abuses 'more preferable'.

question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"The senior internal auditor visited (A)/ the troubled urban branch (B)/ with a view to inspect (C)/ the high-value commercial credit files. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"The senior internal auditor visited (A)/ the troubled urban branch (B)/ with a view to inspect (C)/ the high-value commercial credit files. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: 'With a view to' is a prepositional phrase where 'to' is a preposition; it must be followed by a gerund (V1 + ing). Use 'with a view to inspecting'.
explanation.hi: 'With a view to' के बाद Gerund (V1 + ing) का प्रयोग अनिवार्य है। 'inspecting' सही है।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'With a view to + Gerund'.
Elimination: Look closely at parts C and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: Look forward to / With a view to / Accustomed to + V-ING.

examTip.en: Exam Tip: Look forward to / With a view to / Accustomed to + V-ING.
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: Look forward to / With a view to / Accustomed to + V-ING.

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: Seeing 'to' and blindly applying base verb V1.
trapAlert.hi: ट्रैप अलर्ट: Seeing 'to' and blindly applying base verb V1.

question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"Being a gazetted public holiday (A)/ declared by the state administration, (B)/ the clearing operations staff (C)/ enjoyed an extended weekend. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"Being a gazetted public holiday (A)/ declared by the state administration, (B)/ the clearing operations staff (C)/ enjoyed an extended weekend. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: As written, 'Being a gazetted public holiday' improperly modifies 'the clearing operations staff'. It requires an impersonal subject: 'It being a gazetted public holiday'.
explanation.hi: Dangling Participle: 'Being a gazetted public holiday' का स्वतंत्र कर्ता 'It' होना चाहिए, अन्यथा स्टाफ स्वयं छुट्टी प्रतीत होता है।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'Dangling Participle (Unattached Modifier)'.
Elimination: Look closely at parts A and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: Add 'It' before 'Being' when describing weather, time, or holiday.

examTip.en: Exam Tip: Add 'It' before 'Being' when describing weather, time, or holiday.
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: Add 'It' before 'Being' when describing weather, time, or holiday.

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: Extremely high-frequency trap in SBI & IBPS Clerk Mains.
trapAlert.hi: ट्रैप अलर्ट: Extremely high-frequency trap in SBI & IBPS Clerk Mains.

question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"The financial standing of the public sector bank (A)/ is significantly stronger (B)/ than the newly established (C)/ regional micro-lender. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"The financial standing of the public sector bank (A)/ is significantly stronger (B)/ than the newly established (C)/ regional micro-lender. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: The sentence improperly compares the 'financial standing' (an abstract attribute) directly to 'the regional micro-lender' (an institution). Use 'than that of the newly established...'.
explanation.hi: तुलना वित्तीय स्थिति (financial standing) की हो रही है। अतः 'than that of' का प्रयोग अनिवार्य है।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'Comparison of Unequal Entities (That of)'.
Elimination: Look closely at parts C and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: Compare apples to apples! Financial standing with financial standing ('than that of').

examTip.en: Exam Tip: Compare apples to apples! Financial standing with financial standing ('than that of').
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: Compare apples to apples! Financial standing with financial standing ('than that of').

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: Directly comparing a property to an entire organization.
trapAlert.hi: ट्रैप अलर्ट: Directly comparing a property to an entire organization.

question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"Neither the regional manager nor the branch cashiers (A)/ was present in the currency vault (B)/ when the alarm triggered (C)/ during the unscheduled security drill. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"Neither the regional manager nor the branch cashiers (A)/ was present in the currency vault (B)/ when the alarm triggered (C)/ during the unscheduled security drill. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: In 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject nearest to it. 'cashiers' is plural, so use 'were present', not 'was present'.
explanation.hi: 'neither... nor' में क्रिया निकटतम कर्ता के अनुसार होती है। 'cashiers' बहुवचन है, अतः 'were' का प्रयोग होगा।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'Subject-Verb Concord (Proximity)'.
Elimination: Look closely at parts B and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: Cover the first subject. Only check 'cashiers was' -> error!

examTip.en: Exam Tip: Cover the first subject. Only check 'cashiers was' -> error!
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: Cover the first subject. Only check 'cashiers was' -> error!

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: Don't add both subjects together. Proximity governs!
trapAlert.hi: ट्रैप अलर्ट: Don't add both subjects together. Proximity governs!

question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"The Chairman and Managing Director, (A)/ along with senior audit officers, (B)/ have scheduled an emergency board meeting (C)/ to address the liquidity shortfall. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"The Chairman and Managing Director, (A)/ along with senior audit officers, (B)/ have scheduled an emergency board meeting (C)/ to address the liquidity shortfall. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: When joined by 'along with', the verb agrees with the first subject ('Chairman and Managing Director', singular). Therefore, use 'has scheduled', not 'have scheduled'.
explanation.hi: 'along with' से जुड़ने पर क्रिया प्रथम कर्ता ('Chairman and Managing Director', एकवचन) के अनुसार होगी। 'has scheduled' सही है।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'Subject-Verb Concord (First Subject)'.
Elimination: Look closely at parts C and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: Ignore everything between commas starting with 'along with'.

examTip.en: Exam Tip: Ignore everything between commas starting with 'along with'.
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: Ignore everything between commas starting with 'along with'.

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: The plural noun 'officers' is placed right before the verb to trap you.
trapAlert.hi: ट्रैप अलर्ट: The plural noun 'officers' is placed right before the verb to trap you.

ruleTested: One of the + Plural Noun + Relative Clause

question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"He is one of the most dedicated loan recovery officers (A)/ who has ever worked (B)/ in this rural development bank (C)/ since its establishment. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"He is one of the most dedicated loan recovery officers (A)/ who has ever worked (B)/ in this rural development bank (C)/ since its establishment. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: 'One of the + plural noun + who' takes a plural verb because 'who' refers to the plural antecedent ('officers'). Use 'who have ever worked'.
explanation.hi: 'One of the + बहुवचन संज्ञा + who' में क्रिया बहुवचन होती है क्योंकि 'who' का पूर्ववर्ती 'officers' है। 'have' आएगा।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'One of the + Plural Noun + Relative Clause'.
Elimination: Look closely at parts B and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: Formula: One of the + Plural Noun + who + PLURAL VERB.

examTip.en: Exam Tip: Formula: One of the + Plural Noun + who + PLURAL VERB.
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: Formula: One of the + Plural Noun + who + PLURAL VERB.

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: Don't get tricked by the word 'One'; look for the relative pronoun 'who'.
trapAlert.hi: ट्रैप अलर्ट: Don't get tricked by the word 'One'; look for the relative pronoun 'who'.

ruleTested: A number of vs The number of

question.en:
In the following sentence, find out which part of the sentence has an error. If there is no error, mark 'No Error' (E) as your answer:

"The number of fraudulent online transactions (A)/ reported through payment aggregators (B)/ have increased noticeably (C)/ over the past financial quarter. (D)/ No error (E)"
question.hi:
निम्नलिखित वाक्य में ज्ञात कीजिए कि किस भाग में त्रुटि है। यदि वाक्य त्रुटिहीन है, तो 'कोई त्रुटि नहीं' (E) को उत्तर के रूप में चुनें:

"The number of fraudulent online transactions (A)/ reported through payment aggregators (B)/ have increased noticeably (C)/ over the past financial quarter. (D)/ No error (E)"

explanation.en: 'The number of' specifies a single mathematical statistic and requires a singular verb ('has increased', not 'have increased').
explanation.hi: 'The number of' एक निश्चित संख्या को दर्शाता है और एकवचन क्रिया ('has increased') लेता है।

hints: Concept: Focus on the grammatical rule governing 'A number of vs The number of'.
Elimination: Look closely at parts C and adjacent verbs/connectors.
Exam Shortcut: 'A number of' = Plural verb; 'The number of' = Singular verb.

examTip.en: Exam Tip: 'A number of' = Plural verb; 'The number of' = Singular verb.
examTip.hi: परीक्षा टिप: 'A number of' = Plural verb; 'The number of' = Singular verb.

trapAlert.en: Trap Alert: Seeing 'transactions' right before the verb tricks students into using 'have'.
